_comment: Every reference the site uses, in citation order. The site numbers them [1], [2], ... in this order (IEEE style). 'archive' lists copies kept in the repository (docs/sources/) or as a release asset; archive_sources.py fetches any that are missing. Title style: 'quoted' for articles, web pages and parts of books; 'italic' for books, reports and datasets.
